rows.v: 依次为日常对话、日常独白、教育讨论、学术独白。
4 个部分，每部分 10 题，共 40 题。
约 30 分钟，录音播放 1 遍。
选择题按题面选出规定数量的选项。完成题按题面要求填原词、数字或词库选项。
每个正确答案得 1 分；原始总分换算为整数或半分分数段。
成绩用 0—9 分数段报告。考试不设统一及格线。原始分换算分数段的门槛随试卷略有变化。

cards.title: 题型
rows: 单项选择
考试为 3 选 1，考细节或主旨。
Which room has been booked?
多项选择
按题面选出规定数量的选项，每一项都要在录音中有依据。
Choose TWO services included in the price.
配对
把录音中的各项对应到同一份选项。选项能否重复使用，看题面。
Match each activity with its location.
平面图、地图、图解标注
按图中位置找对应的名称，填原词或从所给名称中选。
Entrance: ___
表单、笔记、表格、流程填空
用录音原词或所给词库补全信息，词数看题面。
Type of membership: ___
句子填空
填入录音原词，意思和语法都要接得上原句。
The package includes ___.
简答
只写所问的信息，不抄整句。
What document is required?

cards.title: 四部分材料
rows: Part 1
日常对话。把提问者的需求和对方确认的服务信息对应起来。
A visitor asks a receptionist about a room.
Part 2
日常独白。一名讲者介绍场所或活动安排。
A guide explains the facilities at a sports centre.
Part 3
教育讨论。区分各人的建议、理由和最后的决定。
A student and a tutor discuss a project.
Part 4
学术独白。区分概念、例子和结论。
A lecturer explains a method of studying soil.

cards.title: 作答限制与成绩

body.p: 字数限制每题不同，以本题题面为准。填原词时保留原文的词形。词库题从所给选项中选。

body.box:
Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS.
Required document: ___
Recording: Please bring a membership card.
Answer: membership card

body.p: membership card 是两个词，符合上限。a membership card 是三个词，超出上限。只写 card 则缺了证件种类。表中已给出的单位不再写进空格。
考试的单项选择是三选一，本课程用四选一练习。考试的多项选择，本课程改为从四个组合中选一个。课程录音最多用两个合成声音。这些是课程的练习形式，考试形式以官方说明为准。
课程通过率只用来检查学习，不能换算成雅思分数段。课内正确率达到 0.8，也不对应某个分数段。原始分换算分数段的门槛随试卷略有变化。

cards.src: I1 听力题型说明；I5 计分说明

items.stem: Which sequence matches the four Listening parts?
options: Everyday dialogue, everyday monologue, educational discussion, academic monologue
Everyday monologue, everyday dialogue, academic monologue, educational discussion
Educational discussion, academic monologue, everyday dialogue, everyday monologue
Academic monologue, educational discussion, everyday monologue, everyday dialogue
items.why: 概述列出的顺序是日常对话、日常独白、教育讨论、学术独白，与第一项一致。

items.stem: How does official single-answer multiple choice differ from this course's adaptation?
options: The official task has four options; the course has three.
The official task has three options; the course has four.
Both use three options for a single answer.
Both use four options for a single answer.
items.why: 依据：考试的单项选择是三选一，本课程用四选一练习。答案是第二项。

items.stem: A source-word task allows NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS. The recording says 'a membership card'. Which entry gives the required document within that limit?
options: a membership card
a card
membership card
membership
items.why: membership card 是两个词，保留了证件种类，即第三项。第一项是三个词，超出上限。

items.stem: Which statement describes the Listening recordings?
options: About 40 minutes, with each recording played once
About 30 minutes, with each recording played twice
About 10 minutes, with each recording played twice
About 30 minutes, with each recording played once
items.why: 概述写明录音约 30 分钟，只放 1 遍，即第四项。第二项把播放次数说成了 2 遍。

items.stem: Which statement describes the raw score?
options: Forty questions are worth one mark each when correct.
Ten questions are worth four marks each when correct.
Four parts are worth one raw mark each when completed.
Forty questions are converted directly into forty bands.
items.why: 概述写明共 40 题，每个正确答案得 1 分，即第一项。

items.stem: What follows from reaching this course's 0.8 threshold?
options: It establishes a fixed official band for that raw percentage.
It meets a course target without establishing an official band.
It fixes the same raw-score boundary for every test version.
It establishes a universal IELTS pass mark of eight bands.
items.why: 课程通过率只用来检查学习，不对应雅思分数段，即第二项。
